AxTable.DeveloperDocumentation: Stores connection, OAuth2 credentials, and cached Bearer token parameters for the UTC Salesforce B2C Customer Push integration.
AxTable.Label: Salesforce Integration Parameters

AxTableField.Name: IsEnabled
AxTableField.HelpText: Enable or disable real-time customer push to Salesforce.
AxTableField.Label: Enable Salesforce Push

AxTableField.Name: ApiEndpointUrl
AxTableField.HelpText: Salesforce Apex REST Customer Push endpoint URL (e.g. https://...my.salesforce.com/services/apexrest/utc/v1/customers).
AxTableField.Label: Customer Push Endpoint URL

AxTableField.Name: ClientId
AxTableField.HelpText: Connected App OAuth2 Consumer Key (Client ID).
AxTableField.Label: Client ID

AxTableField.Name: ClientSecret
AxTableField.HelpText: Connected App OAuth2 Consumer Secret (Client Secret) - masked in UI.
AxTableField.Label: Client Secret

AxTableField.Name: CachedAccessToken
AxTableField.HelpText: Cached OAuth2 Bearer access token (valid for 120 minutes from issue time).
AxTableField.Label: Cached Access Token

AxTableField.Name: TokenExpiresAt
AxTableField.HelpText: UTC timestamp when the cached access token expires.
AxTableField.Label: Token Expires At (UTC)

AxTableField.Name: MaxRetryCount
AxTableField.HelpText: Maximum number of retry attempts for transient HTTP 5xx or network failures (HTTP 400 is never retried).
AxTableField.Label: Max Retry Count

AxTableField.Name: HttpTimeoutSeconds
AxTableField.HelpText: HTTP request timeout in seconds for Salesforce API calls.
AxTableField.Label: HTTP Timeout (Seconds)
